items.title: George Mitchell Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: There was some of Ida Cox too

ctx.x: I think it was...I made some...made a recording with some singer. I don't know...I don't know what...what the...the recordings were. Yeah. I believe it was...I believe Maureenie.

Oh really? I believe Maureenie was... I might have been. I'll have to listen. I have most of those Maureenie records. I...I...I believe...I believe it was Maureenie. There was Maureenie. There was some of Ida Cox too...된 you ever work with her...Ida Cox...

with her? It was one or two singers, but you see, those things just happened so, you know, they'd come after me. The night maybe something happened, you know, I'd have a day or two and I'd go around and think no more of it. Yeah. Well, when you made those jelly roll records, did you rehearse very long or just run over the tunes in a hurry? Well, no, we'd rehearse about two, three times, two, three times. Several rehearsals. Several rehearsals before we made them. And when you went to make the records, did you…
